meta.title: Vendor fills a dropdown column "Make": leave it unselected when it is required
gaps: Select or verify the required buyer-added Make dropdown column is left unselected while submitting a quote of 100.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select or verify the required buyer-added Make dropdown column is left unselected while submitting a quote of 100.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live event for the vendor-side test.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.

args.need: leave the required Make dropdown unselected, enter a quote of 100, and submit the quote

steps.note: The catalog has no step that can target or confirm the required Make dropdown state.
Confirm that submission remains refused when the required Make option is still unselected.
